$description: Copy relevant settings into your project's .qoder/settings.json or ~/.qoder/settings.json

$configNotes.maxContextFiles: Soft limit. Agent can exceed with justification. Default: 30
$configNotes.maxFileReadLines: Soft limit per file. Prefer targeted reads. Default: 200
$configNotes.enableEvidenceLedger: Track sources of factual claims. Recommended: true
$configNotes.enableUiAntiAiReview: Check for AI-generated UI patterns. Recommended: true for web projects
$configNotes.enableBrowserVerification: Use browser to verify UI changes. Requires dev server. Default: true
$configNotes.enableTokenBudgetReport: Output context usage stats. Useful for debugging. Default: false
$configNotes.preferredDesignSystem: auto=detect from project, or: shadcn/ui, antd, mui, custom. Default: auto
$configNotes.forbiddenUiPatterns: UI patterns to avoid. Add custom patterns as strings
$configNotes.requiredVerificationCommands: Commands to always run, e.g. ['npm run lint', 'npm test']
